items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers standby buses and brings screens 2 and 4 alive.
items.label: Battery

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connect GPU via EFB first, then press EXT PWR. Provides full AC/DC power for cockpit prep without running an engine.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Green and red wingtip lights. Standard to set early so ground crew can see the aircraft is powered.
items.label: Nav Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the wing leading edges. On from power-up for ground visibility and ice inspection.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the floor-track evacuation lighting. Set and forget.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Main Panel. Review any startup alerts on DU 2 and 4, then clear them.
items.label: Alerts

items.info: Center Pedestal. MP, PED, OVHD and FLOOD light controls. Set for ambient conditions.
items.label: Interior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press test button to verify all annunciator bulbs illuminate, then set BRT or DIM as required.
items.label: Annunciator Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Test each fuel pump and cross-feed valve. Verify on SYS ENGINE page.
items.label: Fuel Pumps Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both engine fuel pumps ON, cross-feed OFF.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Press SW Test button for CAB OK and SVCE OK. Cross-check with SYS AIR CABIN page.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify three green gear-down indications.
items.label: Landing Gear Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. HYDPWR section — Blue Pump, Aux Pump, and Green Pump all to ON. The ATR needs hydraulic pressure for the prop brake system and flight controls.
items.label: Hydraulic Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Test both engines: verify fire handle IN, squib lights illuminate, FAULT and FIRE test positions trigger correct warnings.
items.label: Engine Fire Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both L and R switches ON. Prevents fogging and ice buildup on the windscreen.
items.label: Windshield Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Main supply valve. Check oxygen pressure on SYS AIR CABIN page.
items.label: Oxygen Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seat belts sign ON.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify main electrical power panel and SYS ELEC page. DC generators, AC wild power, BTC positions all nominal.
items.label: Electrical Panel

items.info: Overhead Panel. All lights OFF except amber AFR Air Bleed FAULT (normal with no bleed source yet).
items.label: Anti-Icing Panel

items.info: Overhead Panel. All lights OFF except amber Blue and Green Pump LO PR lights (normal with engines off). Verify on SYS ACW-HYD page.
items.label: Hydraulic Panel

items.info: Center Pedestal. Automatic Takeoff Power Control System test. Selector to ARM, verify green light, then test each engine for UPTRIM and AUTOFEATHER annunciations.
items.label: ATPCS Test

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify pitch, aileron and rudder trim controls move freely and indicators respond.
items.label: Trims

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set and verify ACCU BRAKE pressure on SYS ACW-HYD page.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Push aft to engage. Locks flight controls to prevent wind damage while parked.
items.label: Gust Lock

items.info: Center Pedestal. Run built-in test, then leave in STBY until ready for taxi.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Center Pedestal. SURV page. Leave in STBY until lineup.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Center Pedestal. SURV page. Set TCAS to AUTO mode.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Center Main Panel. Rotary selector to TO position. Sets engine power limits for takeoff.
items.label: Power Management

items.info: Center Main Panel. Both EEC 1+2 depressed IN with no fault lights. Controls engine FADEC.
items.label: EEC 1+2

items.info: Center Main Panel. Press and hold ICE Test button, verify alerts appear.
items.label: Ice Detection Test

items.info: Glareshield. Press test button and verify aural and visual GPWS alerts.
items.label: GPWS Test

items.info: Center Main Panel. Press and hold Anti-Skid test button, verify alerts and no fault lights.
items.label: Anti-Skid Test

items.info: MCDU. Walk through pages in order: POS INIT (copy GPS position), WEIGHT (populate fields), PERF INIT (cruise altitude and mode), FPLN INIT/ROUTE (FROM/TO, SID, STAR, waypoints, remove discontinuities). EXEC after each page.
items.label: FMS Preflight

items.info: Glareshield. Set HDG and COURSE to departure runway heading, NAV source as desired, preselect cleared altitude.
items.label: FGCP

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set COM and NAV frequencies for departure. Verify on VCP page.
items.label: COM & NAV Radios

items.info: Main Panel. Set both altimeters to current QNH/local pressure.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Verify airspeed, altitude and VSI show no flags. Check FMA, EADI, EHSI on both Captain and F/O sides.
items.label: PFD

items.info: Main Panel. Select ND on both sides, cross-check headings match, verify no flags.
items.label: Navigation Display

items.info: MFD PERF page. Select TO DATA tab and press CONFIRM. Verifies V-speeds are set and torque bugs are correct.
items.label: Takeoff Data

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set pitch trim to takeoff position shown on EWD.
items.label: Elevator Trim

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set aileron and rudder trims to zero/neutral.
items.label: Aileron & Rudder Trim

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red anti-collision light on top and bottom of fuselage. Required before any engine start so ground crew know engines are about to spool.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Backwall panel. Cockpit Door Locking System. Secures the flight deck door.
items.label: CDLS

items.info: Center Main Panel. Provides additional power margin for takeoff in hot/high conditions or heavy weight.
items.label: Engine Boost

items.info: Overhead Panel. Engine Start Selector to A+B, press START 2 button, verify green ON light. Monitor NH% on SYS ENGINE page. At 10% NH, move Condition Lever 2 to FTR. Monitor ITT — abort if exceeding 950°C.
items.label: Engine 2

items.info: Center Pedestal: press HYD AUX PUMP, next to the power levers. Overhead Panel: wait for the green READY light, then lift the guard and set Prop Brake OFF. Wait for NP to stabilize around 70% and LO PITCH annunciation — then move Condition Lever 2 to AUTO.
items.label: Prop Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Same procedure as Engine 2. Start Selector to A+B, press START 1, CL 1 to FTR at 10% NH, then AUTO when NP stabilizes.
items.label: Engine 1

items.info: Overhead Panel. Return ignition selector to OFF after both engines are running.
items.label: Start Selector

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify DC Generator 1+2 and ACW Generator 1+2 show no fault lights. Check BTC positions are closed (horizontal).
items.label: Generators

items.info: Overhead Panel. All three switches ON (Captain, Standby, F/O). Prevents icing on pitot and static probes.
items.label: Probe Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Unguard, press TRU, re-guard. Transformer Rectifier Unit converts AC to DC for main bus.
items.label: TRU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnect GPU now that engines provide power.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify no fault lights on hydraulic panel. Blue and Green pump LO PR lights should now be extinguished with engines running.
items.label: Hydraulic Panel

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set flap lever to 15 degrees for takeoff.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Main Panel. Press FWS recall button to verify no hidden warnings remain.
items.label: FWS Recall

items.info: Overhead Panel. Taxi and T.O. lights illuminate the taxiway ahead.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Captain lateral console. Enable after pushback is complete for taxi control.
items.label: Nose Wheel Steering

items.info: Center Pedestal. Release it as you start the taxi.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Glareshield. Select HDG mode, arm NAV mode, preselect cleared altitude, set IAS bug to VFTO or AUTO.
items.label: FGCP

items.info: Pedals. Apply brakes briefly during initial taxi roll to confirm stopping power.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Main Panel. Verifies flaps, trim and other takeoff-critical settings are correct. Triggers a warning if anything is misconfigured.
items.label: TO Config Test

items.info: Center Pedestal. Pull forward to disengage. Flight controls must be free before takeoff.
items.label: Gust Lock

items.info: Controls. Move stick and pedals through full range, verify free and correct movement on EWD.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Glareshield (FGCP). Press the Sync HDG button to center the lateral flight director bar before entering the runway. Avoids an immediate heading mode capture on the wrong heading.
items.label: Lateral FD Bar

items.info: Center Pedestal. Momentarily move the Rudder Trim control left then back to center. Ensures the yaw axis is zeroed before the takeoff roll.
items.label: Rudder Cam

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify both condition levers are in AUTO position.
items.label: Condition Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Confirm flap lever matches 15 degree indication on EWD.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Main Panel. Confirm Power Management selector is in TO position.
items.label: Power Management

items.info: Center Pedestal. SURV page. Switch transponder to ALT/ON and TCAS to TA/RA for departure.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Overhead Panel. White strobe lights ON when entering the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights. ON for takeoff and below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. Activate if weather is a factor.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Center Pedestal. Advance power levers to NOTCH detent for normal takeoff (90% TQ). Use RAMP for reserve takeoff (100% TQ) if required. Monitor torque and NP reaching 100%.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Pedals. Release brakes to begin the takeoff roll. Use tiller for steering up to 70 KIAS, then rudder only.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Controls. At Vr slowly rotate to approximately 5 degrees pitch. Maintain at least V2 and do not exceed VFTO (white F speed bug).
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main Panel. Retract at positive rate of climb.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Main Panel. At acceleration altitude (typically 1,000 ft AGL), rotate PWR MGT selector to CLB. Lower nose to approximately 8 degrees or follow flight director.
items.label: Power Management

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract flaps when at or above VFTO (white F speed bug). Acceleration to climb speed (160/170 KIAS) should be positive.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Glareshield. Damps dutch roll oscillation. Engage once gear is up and aircraft is accelerating.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Overhead Panel. Back ON if they were selected off for takeoff. The bleeds supply pressurization and air conditioning.
items.label: Engine Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. No longer needed once airborne.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Glareshield. Engage at own discretion once established in climb. Verify LNAV active and IAS mode selected.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Overhead Panel. If icing conditions exist, activate engine and airframe anti-ice.
items.label: Anti-Icing

items.info: Main Panel. Set barometric reference to STD (29.92 / 1013) when passing transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Not required above 10,000 ft.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Wing illumination not needed in cruise.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn off seat belt sign if conditions are smooth.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Main Panel. Verify cabin altitude is climbing normally and no warnings are present.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Center Main Panel. Rotate PWR MGT selector to CRZ at cruise altitude. Power levers remain at NOTCH, condition levers at AUTO.
items.label: Power Management

items.info: MFD. Scan ELEC, CABIN, ACW-HYD and ENGINE system pages for any anomalies.
items.label: MFD Systems

items.info: Main Panel. Verify cabin altitude and differential pressure are normal.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: MCDU. PROG page shows TOD distance and estimated fuel on board at destination.
items.label: MCDU PROG Page

items.info: Overhead Panel. Activate if entering visible moisture at or below freezing temperatures.
items.label: Anti-Icing

items.info: MCDU. Verify FPLN page has correct runway, approach and STAR. Check waypoint constraints. Enter wind data on PERF APPROACH page.
items.label: Approach Data

items.info: Main Panel. Check and set landing elevation, AUTO or MAN.
items.label: Landing Elevation

items.info: Main Panel. Set MDA or DH as appropriate for the approach type.
items.label: Minimums

items.info: Center Pedestal. Preselect ILS frequency and missed approach frequencies. Set NAV source and ILS course on FGCP.
items.label: COM & NAV Radios

items.info: Main Panel. Clear any accumulated warnings before approach.
items.label: FWS Recall

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seat belt sign ON for descent.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: MCDU/FGCP. Activate VNAV or set VS to approximately 5 times groundspeed. Manage speed manually. Normal profile: 240 KIAS above 10,000 ft, 170-200 below.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Main Panel. Set local QNH when passing transition flight level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main Panel. Verify cabin is descending normally and landing elevation is correct.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Overhead Panel. ON when passing 10,000 ft or entering terminal area.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates wing leading edges for ice inspection and visibility.
items.label: Wing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Ensure seat belt sign is ON.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Main Panel. Verify cabin altitude matches landing elevation.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Center Pedestal. Deploy flaps to 15 degrees at or below 170 KIAS (ATR 42: 180, ATR 72: 185 max).
items.label: Flaps 15

items.info: Main Panel. Extend at or below 170 KIAS (ATR 72 limit). Verify three green lights.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Main Panel. Set PWR MGT to TO for landing power reserves.
items.label: Power Management

items.info: Overhead Panel. Additional forward illumination for approach and landing.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. ATR 72: 30. ATR 42: 25 or 35, as briefed. ATR 72 limit 150 KIAS.
items.label: Flaps Full

items.info: EWD. Rudder travel limiter, ATR 72 only. TLU LO SPEED shows below 185 kt, giving full rudder travel for landing.
items.label: TLU Lo Speed

items.info: Glareshield. Disconnect autopilot and yaw damper no later than 200 ft AGL.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Controls. Maintain VAPP plus no more than 10 knots until flare.
items.label: Approach Speed

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retard power levers to IDLE at approximately 20 ft, flare to about 3 degrees pitch.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. After touchdown, move the power levers past the flight idle gate to ground idle. The gate blocks this in flight.
items.label: Power Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Apply reverse thrust as needed after touchdown. Use symmetrically.
items.label: Reverse

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retract flaps fully after vacating the runway.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. All three switches OFF.
items.label: Probe Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. All anti-ice and de-ice systems OFF.
items.label: Anti-Icing

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: TRU

items.info: Center Pedestal. Push aft to lock flight controls.
items.label: Gust Lock

items.info: Center Pedestal. SURV page. Return to standby on the ground.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Center Pedestal. Reset pitch, aileron and rudder trims to zero.
items.label: Trims

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set parking brake at the gate.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. At least 2 min after vacating the runway, move CL 1 to FTR, wait 30 s, then FUEL S.O. to shut down engine 1.
items.label: Condition Lever 1

items.info: Center Pedestal. Move CL 2 to FTR and wait for NP to stabilize, then FUEL S.O. to shut down engine 2. If using Hotel Mode, leave at FTR and engage prop brake instead.
items.label: Condition Lever 2

items.info: Overhead Panel. Engines are shut down, anti-collision light no longer needed.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Center Main Panel.
items.label: Engine Boost

items.info: Overhead Panel. Main supply valve OFF.
items.label: Oxygen Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. All exterior lights OFF.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disarm emergency exit lighting.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both engine fuel pumps OFF.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Backwall panel.
items.label: CDLS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Last switch. Aircraft goes dark.
items.label: Battery

description: A rugged regional workhorse of a turboprop built for short-field performance, serving routes from island hops to mountain airstrips.
